description: Brings the completed orders of a shop that have no Sales Order yet into ERPNext: the shop's old orders, and those completed while the order sync wasn't watching. Each gets its Sales Order and, when its payment can be booked, its Sales Invoice and Payment Entry, submitted together. The order sync itself makes no invoices or payments.

fields.description: The completed orders of the shop that have no Sales Order yet, created between these days. Leave them empty for all of them. An import can be started again: orders it imported are left out, the others are tried again.
fields.label: Orders

fields.description: Off: no stock moves, and each Sales Order is closed, so it reserves no stock. To invoice such an order by hand, re-open it first. On: each order gets a Delivery Note dated when WooCommerce completed it. That needs stock on that day, and may need the role that may post back-dated stock entries. It reposts stock and lowers today's stock, which the stock sync sends to the shop. An order whose delivery fails isn't imported, and a later run can take it, perhaps without this tick.
fields.label: Make Delivery Notes

fields.description: The serial numbers to put on the Delivery Notes, so each customer's product carries its serial and its warranty starts on the day of the delivery. A CSV whose first row is exactly order_number,serial_no, then one serial per row: the order's number without #, and the serial as the site spells it. Every serial must be Active in the warehouse the shop's orders ship from, and have come into stock by the day its order was completed. An order of a serialized Item needs as many serials of it as it has units. Saving checks the file, and refuses it whole for one bad row. Template · Guide for converting earlier records, to give to an LLM that writes the conversion script.
fields.label: Serial Numbers

fields.description: An imported order's Sales Invoice is submitted together with its Payment Entry, on the default account of the Mode of Payment of its payment method, both dated when WooCommerce says it was paid. An order whose payment method has no Mode of Payment here is skipped until it gets one.
